text:
Hannah Cole: Quick brief 1 need a compact "templates + flowmap" kit for the benchmark launch. Deliverables: hero banner (1600x420), condensed social set (1:1, 16:9, 9:16), email header (600x200), 3 segmented landing tiles (product, platform, enterprise) and a modular SVG flowmap (webinar -> lead qual -> demo -> trial) with labeled nodes for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Also: manifest JSON, alt text file, and a short CSV mapping assets -> UTMs. Deadline: next Wed EOD.

Diego Alvarez: Got it. For the segmented tiles, do you want different copy per audience? i.e., product: speed-first, enterprise: SLA/compliance.

Hannah Cole: Yes — three tailored hooks and matching CTAs. We'll also A/B the primary CTA on social (Register vs View benchmark).

Mina Zhou: Motion? Lottie allowed for landing hero? Accessibility constraints?

Hannah Cole: Lottie for web only, provide static PNG & GIF fallback. Must include reduced-motion preferred PNGs. Dark-mode versions required.

Brand Review: Brand quick rules: palette-v3 tokens only; headline = Inter Display; body = Inter. No unapproved neon. Contrast: body >= 4.5:1. Provide alt text drafts and token names in Figma layers.

Diego Alvarez: For the flowmap - sales wants optional stat labels (median latency ms, $/1k tokens). Make them a separate toggle group in the SVG so reps can hide/show. Also include small legend for "SLA tier" icons.

Mina Zhou: I'll componentize nodes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) so they can be recolored. Export targets: SVG for web, PNG @2x for web retina, PDF for sales, and a compressed PNG for email. Filenames: asset-channel-size-v1.ext.

DesignOps Bot: Blocked a 90-min slot for Mina Tue 9:30am PT. If you need rush, request priority. I'll auto-create the deliverable checklist and a template manifest in the Figma file.

Hannah Cole: Also need a tiny CSV with UTMs per asset: file, campaign, medium. DemandGen wants this for scheduling. Example row: `hero-web-1600x420.png,benchmark-webinar,web`.

DemandGen Bot: Noted. We'll consume CSV for automation. Please include final filenames and CTA links when ready. We also want a short alt_text column for emails.

Mina Zhou: ETA for first pass: Tue 3pm PT. I'll post Figma link and attach a sample manifest snippet.

Hannah Cole: Copy: I'll post three hooks in 1 hour. Keep CTAs concise. Also flag any accessibility tradeoffs in Figma comments.

Brand Review: We'll run a 24h sweep after Figma link. If any contrast or font issues, we'll add inline notes.

Mina Zhou: Will include dark-mode layers, reduced-motion PNGs, and an `exports/manifest.json` in the Figma file. Example manifest snippet in comments: [{"filename":"hero-web-1600x420.png","size":"1600x420","alt":"Webinar hero - Inference economics that scale"}].

Hannah Cole: Perfect. Locking deadline Wed EOD. If anything blocks (contrast, motion), flag immediately. Thanks team! :rocket:
